name: Pearls | 200mg Gummies | Tart Cherry 10:1 CBN:THC
description:
The perfect bedtime edible and the first of its kind, our Tart Cherry Pearls are infused with a 10:1 ratio of CBN to THC. Each Pearl contains 25mg CBN and 2.5mg THC to promote restful sleep with minimal psychoactive effects. Sweet dreams.

25mg CBN:2.5mg THC per gummy | 250mg CBN:25mg THC per container | 10 ct
